_doc: Ashfall env ground tiles v1 (env pass 1 r2, approved by Director). 32x32, no gutter (baked once into terrCanvas at 1:1). wang: per terrain 81 corner-Wang tiles, 3 colours per tile vertex; index = tl + 3tr + 9br + 27bl, vertex colours from a stateless hash (HANDOFF-env.md section 2). mask: dual-grid transition masks (black = layer present), bits = corner tiles at or above the layer, TL=1 TR=2 BR=4 BL=8, 4 variants; used with destination-in at bake time; the same mask drawn at (+1,+1) with alpha 0.35 is the lip shadow for "lip" layers.

wang.corners: tl = C(tx,ty), tr = C(tx+1,ty), br = C(tx+1,ty+1), bl = C(tx,ty+1); C(vx,vy) = hash(vx,vy,terrainSalt) % 3

layers.game: GROUND sub-type: scorched flag (crater surrounds, nuke/fire sites, noise blobs)
GROUND sub-type: within 1-2 tiles of a Salvage heap or Angel Wreck
